messages:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] Severity: high — elevated inference queue latency in eu-west1 GPUs. Observed token processing lag > 2s for some requests, autoscaler not keeping up. Alert ID: INC-20260315-1818.
Jordan: ack — I'm oncall. Starting triage.
Jordan: quick check — is this affecting hosted and dedicated customers or just dedicated pools?
Alyssa: looks like dedicated eu-west1 pools primarily, some hosted fallbacks tripped but most requests still being served from eu-west fallback region.
Mike: I'm seeing GPU utilization at 98% on the n1 pool, pending pods queueing. Autoscaler metrics show scale-up lag ~4m.
Jordan: starting temporary mitigation: 1) increase autoscaler max replicas for eu-west1 pool, 2) enable regional spillover to eu-north, 3) apply short-term burst capacity (if available).
Emily: ProductOps note — a handful of customers in EU:enterprise-tier reported increased latency; CS alerted and we have a ticket open.
SRE Rotation: Jordan, tagging infra to lift max replicas. Mike can you run the scale command?
Mike: running now.
Mike: ```
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-infer-eu-west1 --replicas=40 -n redwood-infer
```
Mike: submitted. Pods creating; kube events show image pull/initialization.
Jordan: while pods come up, enable model-variant fallback to a lower-memory quantized variant to reduce per-request memory. Alyssa, can you flip the routing rule?
Alyssa: doing the routing flip now. Route change applied for canary customers, rolling to 50% traffic.
Alyssa: ```
# routing override
route.set(region="eu-west1", policy="fallback-quantized", pct=50)
```
OpsBot: Autoscaler limit increased from 20 -> 40 for pool eu-west1 by Mike at 2026-03-15T18:20:42Z.
Jordan: monitoring latency post-actions. Mike — any preemptions or node-level OOMs?
Mike: saw two preemptions on low-priority VMs, recovering, no OOMs in model containers but high GC cycles.
Jordan: good. Emily — can you coordinate a short customer advisory: say we're mitigating a regional capacity spike, traffic diverted, expected impact reduced. Keep it factual.
Emily: on it. Draft to CS channel and will post to affected customers.
ProductOps: Also flagging this for postmortem — looks like autoscaler policy didn't account for bursty seq lengths from a customer test job.
Jordan: agreed. I'll schedule postmortem. Action items now: 1) investigate autoscaler responsiveness & policy thresholds (owner: Mike), 2) detect noisy tenants and create hard caps or sacrificial queues (owner: Alyssa), 3) evaluate cross-region spillover SLAs and automated routing (owner: Jordan), 4) add burst credits/priority for emergency scaling (owner: SRE Rotation).
Jordan: creating a tracking ticket in infra backlog and will assign owners.
Jordan: creating short-term incident summary below for timeline and customer impact.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-20260315-1818. Summary draft saved to https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260315-1818
Mike: I'm collecting relevant metrics: pod start times, kube-scheduler backlog, autoscaler logs. Dropping links in tracker.
Alyssa: adding routing logs and the decision to serve quantized model variant. Will include config diffs.
Emily: Customer advisory sent to CS at 18:33 UTC. Notified top 5 impacted accounts.
ProductOps: suggest we add an automated job to run a synthetic high-seq-length load test each week against eu-west to exercise autoscaler. Might catch regressions.
Jordan: agreed — mark as an action item. Also we should run a postmortem within 72 hours. I'm proposing 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC for the meeting. Anyone object?
SRE Rotation: That works for rotation. I'll shepherd the postmortem doc.
Mike: fine. I'll prepare the technical appendix (metrics, logs, scale commands).
Alyssa: I'll prepare routing and model fallback notes.
Emily: I'll include customer impact summary and CS timeline.
ProductOps: I'll slot the meeting and send calendar invites; will cc legal for any escalation.
Jordan: closing loop — current status: autoscaler increase + routing fallback + burst capacity reduced latency to normal for most traffic. Remaining tasks are the postmortem and remediation items.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-20260315-1818 marked as mitigated at 2026-03-15T18:42:07Z.
Jordan: creating infra ticket now: IR-4261 (Investigate autoscaler scale-up latency and add mitigation knobs). Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/IR-4261
Jordan: owners assigned in ticket: Mike (tech lead), Alyssa (routing lead), SRE Rotation (runbook updates).
Mike: quick note — autoscaler logs show a throttled API call to cloud provider during spike. I'll dig into provider-side rate limits and fallback behavior.
Alyssa: for noisy tenant detection, I'll propose a per-tenant request cap and backpressure mechanism in the routing layer.
SRE Rotation: I'll draft runbook additions: emergency-scale play, cross-region spillover checklist, customer notification templates.
Emily: CS follow-up: one customer asked for SLA credit assessment; ProductOps, can you handle?
ProductOps: noted — will coordinate with finance/legal if needed.
Jordan: thanks everyone. Postmortem invite sent. I'll update the incident thread with link to the postmortem doc and the remediation tracker after the meeting.
IncidentBot: Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-17T15:00Z. Postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-20260315-1818
